FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Creative Pulse Advertising is a full-service advertising agency specializing in digital and traditional marketing strategies for a diverse client base. Our core operations encompass brand development, strategic planning, creative design, media buying, and performance analytics to ensure effective communication and engagement with target audiences. We pride ourselves on adhering to all advertising regulations and employing a transparent approach to client interactions, including the use of formal contracts that clearly define project specifications and deliverables. Our team is continuously trained on the latest industry standards and data privacy practices to minimize risks and protect our clients’ interests. Additionally, we leverage secure technologies to safeguard sensitive client data, ensuring compliance with cybersecurity protocols and maintaining the integrity of all advertising campaigns.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 01/15/2023, a client claimed $5,000 in damages due to a miscommunication about advertising specifications, which resulted in an incorrect ad placement. The matter was resolved amicably with a settlement. Status: Closed.
